registrationStatus: Working-tree scope recorded before implementation; not a committed financial preregistration.
purpose: Compose ppo-objective-v2 and gae-targets-v2 with causal replay-v3, transition-v4 and the functional nine-input optimizer-v5 into a separately versioned PPO learner whose import closure contains no frozen v1 training, evaluation or loading module.
addresses: The learner-composition half of obligation 10's next action for the policy-gradient path only. causal-ppo-v5, frozen sequential_learning.train_ppo and ppo_gradient, F-RL-PPO-FINITE and F-RL-PPO-UNIFORM-CLIP stay unchanged; CE-RL-010/011/012/014/018/019 are not retired.
data: Deterministic synthetic completed bars and exact funding events only.
algorithm: Nine-input, sixteen-hidden-unit tanh actor (three logits) and critic (one value); one uniform draw per step against the cumulative softmax probabilities; terminal-safe GAE-v2 targets; scalar advantage normalization with a 1e-8 scale floor; ppo-objective-v2 loss and gradient; Adam at 0.0003 with unit gradient-norm clipping. Single sequential episode, no reset, horizon search, persistence or checkpoint selection.
budget: Fixed synthetic conformance, repeatability, prefix-rewrite, exact target and sampling oracles, terminal, rejection and failure-injection fixtures; no historical fit, holdout access, hyperparameter search or empirical policy selection.
acceptance: Scoped source, arithmetic-bound, publication-flow and conformance evidence for the composed learner only. No convergence, policy-improvement, data-support, authenticated availability, physical fill, profitability, artifact compatibility, deployment or order authority claim; no original38 status change is implied by registration.
